title: Kooky Sour Portuguese Egg Noodles
description: A sour and glassy-jelly Portuguese dish featuring egg noodles, steam, and Whole30-friendly ingredients, perfect for a unique dinner experience. This recipe combines the flavors of Portugal with a twist of sour and jelly-like texture.

ingredients.name: Egg noodles
ingredients.notes: Made from rice flour or gluten-free alternative

instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the egg noodles and cook according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, apple cider vinegar, and olive oil.
Add the salt and black pepper to the bowl and whisk until combined.
In a separate pot, combine the agar agar powder and 1 cup of water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until the agar agar is dissolved.
Add the agar agar mixture to the bowl with the lime juice mixture and whisk until combined.
Strain the cooked noodles and add them to the bowl with the lime juice and agar agar mixture.
Toss the noodles to coat with the sauce and serve immediately.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
